extras.real_size: farm stand, 2.5 m wide, 1.4 m deep incl. roof overhang, 2.5 m high
extras.notes: roadside farm stand with corrugated tin lean-to roof on cream posts, barn-red board cladding on the counter and back wall; three tilted wooden crates with red and green apples, carrots with greens and potatoes; shelf with honey and jam jars without labels; a tin can with a coin slot as honesty box; a chalkboard with a painted apple and carrot (no text); a straw bale with pumpkins and more pumpkins on the ground; front faces -Y

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
